-- intro: Mercury Magic is a magic attribute that allows the user to generate and manipulate mercury. It is a derivative of Water and Steel Magic.
-- Description:
    This magic attribute allows the user to generate and manipulate mercury at will. The user is able to use this magic without the need of a grimoire. However, in order to use it to its full potential, specific spells are required, which are stored within grimoires. Being liquid metal, the mercury has both high density and great versatility; because of this, it can be shaped into any form the user desires, as well as be used in various destructive attacks and to crush opponents. Furthermore, due to mercury's toxicity, wounds inflicted by this magic can prove fatal if the mercury enters the bloodstream. This toxicity makes it effective against Blood Magic. Compressing and solidifying the mercury can produce a smooth enough surface to reflect Light Magic. Like Steel Magic, Mercury Magic is at a disadvantage against Fire Magic.
-- spell pages: Silver Rain; Silver Spear; Silver Bullet; Silver Blade; Silver Shining Regal Spear; Silver Star of Execution; Silver Guardian; Silver Eagle (spell); Dimension Slash Scorching Light
